scope.summary: Implement auto-distributed trim placement along edges plus cross-seam 3D graphic projection (CG-24, MD Buttons along Pattern Outline + 3D graphics over seamline): distribute N trims (or interval-spaced) along an edge/outline with button+buttonhole pairing across a closure, and allow a 3D-placed graphic to project across seam-adjacent panels per 13.8 + 13.9 §4.
acceptance_criteria: distribute_trims(edge_span, trim_ref, count|interval_mm, start/end margins) creates evenly spaced placements; button+buttonhole paired mode places buttons on one panel and matching buttonholes on the closure counterpart with pairing metadata (fasten simulation MT-171/172 consumes pairs).

Cross-seam graphic projection: a 3D-placed graphic spanning a seam splits into per-panel graphic layers with continuity across the seam in UV space (pattern-space stitching), correct under refit UV preservation (MT-303).
Both exposed via MCP (distribute_trims tool; place_graphic gains cross_seam flag).
scope.risk_if_missed: Button plackets are placed one-by-one otherwise (models will misalign closures), and logos/prints crossing seams (common on tight garments) tear at panel boundaries without cross-seam projection.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; GUI exposure rides the existing Tailor panels and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the Tailor* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.11/13.14.
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long sim/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
